svg.title: The newsroom at 15.40
svg.desc: An open-plan newsroom at twenty to four in the afternoon, with a wall clock, a market ticker, a draft headline on a screen, a telephone on speaker and an editor standing over a seated reporter.

g.text: Twelve things to find. Four of them are counting down to the same moment.
the screens - one of them is a rival's site
the pod where this is being decided
the window on to King Street
the standards policy, pinned up in 2016
Marta Kowal - standards, one floor down
Laran Bakare - business, and he filed it
the phone on speaker - the second plant
the ticker - twenty minutes of trading left
